t: This is Cornwall Gardens, a long, narrow garden square in South Kensington. It's a quiet residential spot, and the material I have on it is slim. Two people are linked to it. Oliffe Legh Richmond was born here in 1881. He became a classical scholar and was Professor of Humanity at Edinburgh University from 1919 to 1948. Christabel Rosamund Bagge, born in 1940, also lived here, though I have nothing more to say about her.
